summary: Phase 10 - All 15 'Swiss Army Knife' features tested. Backend: 39/39 tests PASS after fixing topology route ordering. Frontend: All 15 feature pages load and function correctly. Fixed $NaN display in Billing Recon page.

minor.issue: Dashboard API returns 500 - existing issue from prior phases, not Phase 10

ui_bugs.issue: Showed $NaN when time entry hours/rate were undefined - FIXED

action_items: Dashboard API 500 error should be investigated (existing issue, not Phase 10 related)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 10 features fully functional.
